title: Data Scientist, New Grad (Wearables)
cover_letter:
Dear Pulse Labs hiring team,

I'm applying for the Data Scientist, New Grad (Wearables) role. Over the past year I built a sleep and heart-rate dashboard that combines wearable exports, and an end-to-end churn model with SQL features and SHAP explanations.

I'd bring the same habits to your team: clean pipelines, honest evaluation, and plain-language results.

Thank you for your time,
Sam Rivera

bullets.text: Built a dashboard that combines sleep, HRV and workout data from two wearable exports
Flagged 91% of churned customers with XGBoost and explained each prediction with SHAP

notes: Changed '93% recall' to '91%': the profile says 91%
